arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Panner argued the phrase in Section 411(a) refers to the copyright owner's action.
Mr. Stris argued the Register must make a registration determination before an applicant can sue.
Chief Justice Roberts noted the second sentence of Section 411(a) discusses refused registration.
Justice Breyer compared the situation to hiring an unapproved plumber for home repairs.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines when copyright owners can enforce their rights in federal court. It sets the procedural trigger for all future infringement litigation. The outcome shapes the balance between administrative processing and private legal remedies.
